title: Write a group_anagrams function (hard)
prompt: Write a Python function `group_anagrams(words)` that takes a list of strings and returns a list of lists, where each inner list contains words that are anagrams of each other.

metadata.hard_reason: Requires the sorted-letters-as-key grouping technique (or equivalent); a multi-step algorithm, not a one-liner.
metadata.notes: Correct: groups words with identical sorted-letter signatures into the same inner list. No sandboxed execution yet; graded manually.

test_cases.note: order-insensitive: compare as a set of frozensets, not literal list equality
